You asked for every issue ranked. Practically, this is every issue I can verify from static code inspection without runtime/device instrumentation.

**Ranked Issues (Highest Risk First)**

1. `Critical` New detections can be dropped from UI, making “sounds not popping up” very likely when 3 sounds are already shown.  
`GlobalDetection/appstate.swift:445` appends new sounds, then `GlobalDetection/appstate.swift:477`-`GlobalDetection/appstate.swift:479` keeps `prefix(3)` (oldest), not newest.

2. `Critical` Sound selection changes often do not restart/rebuild active detection pipeline, so newly selected sounds may never be detected until a later restart.  
`Home/SetupMonitoredSoundsView.swift:1811`-`Home/SetupMonitoredSoundsView.swift:1816` only restarts when detection is not running.  
`Home/SetupMonitoredSoundsView.swift:1827`-`Home/SetupMonitoredSoundsView.swift:1829` updates selection without restart.

3. `Critical` Referral-code unlocking is fully client-side with reversible static code list; can be extracted and abused.  
`Support/ReferralCodeManager.swift:70`-`Support/ReferralCodeManager.swift:85`.

4. `Critical` Legacy referral API bypasses CloudKit single-use enforcement entirely.  
`Support/ReferralCodeManager.swift:199`-`Support/ReferralCodeManager.swift:231` (`redeemCode(_:)`) grants access locally.

5. `High` UI layer still directly writes paid state to `UserDefaults`, bypassing centralized subscription state authority.  
`Support/SubView.swift:848`-`Support/SubView.swift:850` and `Support/SubView.swift:1008`-`Support/SubView.swift:1010`.

6. `High` Potential runtime crash from `Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues:)` if two labels localize to same display string.  
`GlobalDetection/appstate.swift:290`-`GlobalDetection/appstate.swift:294`.

7. `High` App can start with zero monitored sounds (silent failure) if `selectedSounds` key is missing while migration flags are already set.  
`GlobalDetection/appstate.swift:97`-`GlobalDetection/appstate.swift:102`, `GlobalDetection/appstate.swift:156`-`GlobalDetection/appstate.swift:163`.

8. `High` Multiple force-unwrapped URLs in app UI paths can crash if URL strings change/are malformed.  
`Support/UpgradePlansView.swift:329`, `Support/UpgradePlansView.swift:333`, `Home/SetupMonitoredSoundsView.swift:4666`, `Home/SetupMonitoredSoundsView.swift:6406`.

9. `High` Sensitive operational data (receipt paths, validation internals) is logged and then forwarded to analytics pipeline.  
`Support/SubscriptionManager.swift:393`-`Support/SubscriptionManager.swift:395`, `Support/SubscriptionManager.swift:515`, `Support/SubscriptionManager.swift:810`.  
`Support/LogManager.swift:260`-`Support/LogManager.swift:263`, `Support/LogManager.swift:335`-`Support/LogManager.swift:358`.

10. `High` User free-text feedback note is sent to Mixpanel (privacy/compliance risk).  
`GlobalDetection/SharedStorage.swift:390`-`GlobalDetection/SharedStorage.swift:394`.

11. `Medium` Widget freshness is intentionally heavily throttled, which can look like stale/broken behavior.  
`GlobalDetection/SharedStorage.swift:232`-`GlobalDetection/SharedStorage.swift:237` reload throttle 60s.  
`TapticWidget/TapticStatusWidget.swift:49`-`TapticWidget/TapticStatusWidget.swift:52` and `TapticWidget/TapticRecentSoundsWidget.swift:54`-`TapticWidget/TapticRecentSoundsWidget.swift:56` timeline every 5/30 min.

12. `Medium` Data race risk in taps history reset path (mixed queue-protected and unprotected writes).  
`GlobalDetection/SharedStorage.swift:171`-`GlobalDetection/SharedStorage.swift:176`.

13. `Medium` `cancelAllTaskRequests()` cancels all BG tasks globally, not only this feature’s requests.  
`GlobalDetection/BackgroundTaskManager.swift:162`.

14. `Medium` Debug environment purchase/status behavior can mask real billing failures during QA.  
`Support/SubscriptionManager.swift:350`-`Support/SubscriptionManager.swift:360`, `Support/SubscriptionManager.swift:1149`-`Support/SubscriptionManager.swift:1157`.

15. `Medium` `fetchProducts()` returns empty array in debug mock mode; some UI paths treat empty as hard failure, leading inconsistent behavior.
